invariants: A result-verification exception replaces the provisional successful attempt document with one failed attempt document at the same canonical path.
The failed attempt preserves the verification failure code and message.
A later retry can succeed after the verification fault is removed.

findings.counterexample: The original focused test called write_attempt_document directly, so removing replace_existing=True from execute_attempt would leave the test passing while the real failure path regressed.
findings.repair: Force result verification to fail inside the existing local-run acceptance test, inspect the replaced attempt document, then remove the fault and prove a later retry succeeds.

mechanical_evidence.real_acceptance: MANTRA run 01M2C2VB6QESCN8MTDQZQ3HNBW retained status failed, code verification_failed, and the loader verification message after provisional publication.
mechanical_evidence.impact_selection: CodeQL one-hop selection widened because imported aliases remain unmapped; the deferred full-suite fallback is recorded as a selector limitation rather than claimed as executed.
